after_soundtrack.recording_collection_scope: Thirty-two original album selections: 31 named archival passages plus the official WaterTower Suite. Rossini composed The Thieving Magpie; Carol of the Bells is an arrangement of the earlier Leontovych composition. Christopher Drake is credited for the game score, not sole authorship of those underlying works. No audition or identical-master assertion.

after_soundtrack.title: Listen to Battlefield 4
after_soundtrack.recording_collection_scope: Seventeen named original soundtrack selections. EA credits Warsaw Theme to Rami; the other selections are credited to Johan Skugge and Jukka Rintamäki. Unnamed first second excluded. Apple secondary artist metadata is not used to invent additional composition credits.
